text: Punjab Gazette Extraordinary, published Tuesday 9 September 2025. Government of the Punjab, Labour & Human Resource Department, notification dated Lahore 8 September 2025, No. SO(L&P) MW/2024, issued under section 6 of the Punjab Minimum Wages Act 2019 and stated to supersede the notification dated 5 September 2024. The copy states minimum rates for adult and adolescent workers in industrial and commercial establishments in Punjab effective 1 July 2025: Rs. 40,000 per month for 26 working days; Rs. 1,538.46 per day for eight working hours; Rs. 192.31 per hour. It also states permitted deductions by agreement for food (Rs. 100 per meal), transport (Rs. 1,800 per month), and accommodation (Rs. 2,000 per month); existing higher wages must not be reduced; employers may pay higher rates; and women must receive equal rates for work of equal value. IMPORTANT: this is a provisional reference-copy transcription. Official-source verification and whether a later notification supersedes it have not been confirmed. Do not treat these rates as verified current rates.
